result.summary: Found 1 issue: a minor styling problem with a low-contrast time badge on a restaurant card.

issues.description: The time estimate badge '15–25 min' on the 'Green Bowl Poké' card has a white background that blends into the light-colored plate image behind it, making the badge's boundaries hard to distinguish.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle drop shadow to the badge, use a darker background color for the badge, or apply a gradient overlay to the image to ensure the badge stands out regardless of the underlying image colors.
